catalogRegistration.role: coordinate-registration audit; photograph owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky; orientation is registered to Galactic coordinates but no observer epoch or Moon ephemeris is claimed; no Sun is baked into the cubemap

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: Google Earth Pro Mars native Sun contract-derived visual standard
provenance.qualification: Mars-derived clean-room Sun appearance and camera-relative motion are shared as a cssEarth presentation standard; no per-object native Sun position or ephemeris is claimed.

controls.label: Visible color
controls.description: NASA CGI Moon Kit display map from LROC color imagery. Small gaps are inpainted; beyond 70° north/south, lower-resolution monochrome LOLA albedo replaces missing color. The app reduces saturation and adjusts tone for display.
controls.title: Visible color: NASA LRO/LROC visible-colour global surface mosaic

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: LOLA elevation relative to a 1,737.4 km reference sphere, shown with color and cartographic shaded relief. This archival map does not share the orbital scene epoch.
controls.title: Elevation: NASA LRO/LOLA elevation map with shaded relief

controls.label: Crust
controls.description: Crustal thickness inferred from GRAIL gravity and lunar topography under assumed crust and mantle densities. This is an interior model shown with shaded relief, not a direct observation of the crust.
controls.title: Crust: NASA GRAIL crustal-thickness map with shaded relief
